text.description_html:
MaxGrade London Leverset

The London Leverset features a classic silhouette known as the wave design. It is one of the most popular styles of levers because of its elegance and timelessness. The London Lever will fit doors 1-3/8 inches thick to 1-3/4 inches thick with 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets. Choose from a passage, privacy, or dummy function.

Features and Specifications of the MaxGrade Wave Leverset:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Overall Length: 5-3/8"
  • Projection: 2-9/16"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-9/16"
  • Backset: Adjustable 2-3/8” or 2-3/4”
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8” - 1-3/4”
  • Latch: 1” housing diameter, 1/2” throw
  • Strike: 1-3/4” x 2-1/4” radius corner, full lip
  • 2-1/8" cross bore
  • Cylinder: 5-pin Schlage or Kwikset keyway
  • Warranty: Lifetime mechanical and finish warranty

When Selecting a Function:

  • Half Dummy: A surfaced mounted, non-working lever. Non-locking and non-latching trim for one side of door. This inactive pull is usually used to match trim.
  • Passage (hall or closet): Latches but does not lock. The latch is activated by turning the either of the two levers.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): Latches and can be locked. Can be locked from the inside with a push-button.

Sold Individually
